description: A festival talent booker must finalize the appearance package for a featured guest at a live awards ceremony, including format, duration, compensation, payment timing, audience interaction, and sponsor-safe presentation.

shared_context.S1: The festival's live awards ceremony is scheduled for Friday evening and will include a featured guest appearance.
shared_context.S2: The current draft package proposes a 30-minute in-person appearance, a live audience question period, a $5,000 fee, payment within 30 days, and sponsor-branded on-screen graphics.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to approve the final guest appearance package and issue the binding production instructions.
shared_context.S4: Before the package is issued, Maya follows the festival's routine final review by asking talent, guild, and sponsorship representatives to report any confirmed requirements.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed with the guest's representative this morning that the guest can appear only by remote link from 6:00 PM to 6:20 PM and will not participate in a live audience question period; he has not yet added the confirmation to the booking file.

PF2.text: Sofia confirmed in the guild's current fee schedule that this appearance requires a minimum guaranteed fee of exactly $8,500 and payment within 7 days of the event; she has not yet attached the schedule to the package review.

PF3.text: Caleb confirmed in the signed sponsor agreement that the guest segment may show only the festival mark, must show no sponsor product or sponsor-branded lower third, and must use the acknowledgment text 'Supported by festival partners' on the event webpage; he has not yet updated the graphics brief.

acceptance_conditions: The guest appearance must be remote.
The segment must last exactly 20 minutes.
The segment must not include a live audience question period.
The guaranteed fee must be exactly $8,500.
Payment must be due within exactly 7 days of the event.
The guest segment must show only the festival mark on screen.
The sponsor acknowledgment on the event webpage must use the exact approved wording.
The final package must encode the talent format, guild payment terms, and sponsor graphics requirements.

content_checks.C8: decisions['appearance_mode'] == 'remote link' or decisions['appearance_mode'] == 'remote link, 6:00 PM to 6:20 PM'

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 6:00 PM-6:20 PM remote window changes the appearance from 30 minutes in person to exactly 20 minutes remote and removes the live audience question period.
The guild schedule changes the fee from the draft $5,000 to exactly $8,500 and changes payment timing from 30 days to exactly 7 days.
The signed sponsor agreement changes the on-screen treatment to include only the festival mark and fixes the webpage acknowledgment as 'Supported by festival partners.'
